documents.title: Multi-omics blood biomarker panel improves early detection signal enrichment in high-risk pancreatic cohorts
documents.abstract_text: A multi-omics blood biomarker and circulating tumor DNA panel improved early detection signal enrichment in high-risk cohort screening for pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma. The study argues for surveillance workflows that remain transparent about risk stratification.

documents.title: Phase II neoadjuvant strategy for resectable pancreatic head adenocarcinoma with biomarker-linked eligibility
documents.abstract_text: This trial registry update highlights phase II neoadjuvant enrollment for pancreatic head adenocarcinoma and emphasizes explainable eligibility criteria, tissue confirmation, and biomarker-linked cohort assignment.

documents.title: Updated surveillance framing for side-branch IPMN and pancreatic cyst follow-up pathways
documents.abstract_text: The update stresses cyst surveillance interval discipline, side-branch IPMN follow-up, and clear escalation workflow language so multidisciplinary teams can separate malignancy suspicion from routine surveillance actions.

documents.title: Foundation model pretraining for pancreatic MRI lesion detection and radiomics benchmark transfer
documents.abstract_text: A pancreas-focused foundation model improved pancreatic MRI lesion detection and radiomics transfer learning across small cohorts, while the authors note the need for stronger benchmark packs and open evaluation bundles.

documents.title: Open pancreatic MRI benchmark pack released with segmentation labels and workflow notes
documents.abstract_text: A new open-source benchmark pack pairs pancreatic MRI segmentation labels with workflow notes, benchmark documentation, and GitHub issue templates intended to accelerate reproducible pancreatic tooling.

documents.title: Regulatory communication on blood biomarker assay evidence for pancreatic oncology studies
documents.abstract_text: The communication summarizes assay validation expectations for blood biomarker and ctDNA evidence in pancreatic oncology studies, reinforcing the need for cited evidence and transparent workflow claims.

documents.title: Navigator-focused radiology workflow stack surfaces explainable pancreatic follow-up opportunities
documents.abstract_text: A new workflow stack report describes navigator dashboards, human review, and escalation workflow design for pancreatic radiology findings, arguing that open-source contributors should prioritize explainable case briefs and benchmark growth over opaque automation.
